Risk: Delayed containment of emerging infectious diseases in Latin America
Problem analysis: Insufficient epidemic prevention and detection infrastructure in Latin American health systems
Theoretical insight: Adoption of proven biosafety practices improves outbreak readiness
Design rationale: Implementation of proven pathogen detection solutions in Latin America
Implementation mechanism: Creation of biosafety entities responsible for laboratory standards and containment
Validation evidence: Global Health Security Index association between biosafety entities and response capacity
Intervention: Legislate and resource Ministry-level biosafety and containment offices across Latin America
Source: https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/sH9i6PSsXZABM5RNq/introducing-the-new-riesgos-catastroficos-globales-team
